cause_cross_check: Not a decode. provider.bin bytes 28..43 are 02020301020000080000f60f10000f00, as root quoted: byte 1 = 2 (interface passes) and the u16 at bytes 6-7 = 2048. m1tp_interface_info (1342be6b) refuses input > 2038, so that predicate is the only failing branch for a 31-byte payload, which matches root's cause. The keyboard's own interface metadata in this boot (L477) has the same layout with control=4086. Both interfaces report report-length fields above the 2038 transport payload cap, so that cap is not a valid bound for those fields. The corrected bound is for root and Grok's revision 002; I propose no relaxation of the 001 verdict.

notes.text: Preserve this attempt as a failed T1 enumeration with a failed T6. The REFUSED rc 77 stays a refusal. A later corrected boot needs a new packet and attempt; this one must not be reclassified.

As designed, a trackpad step failure fails the whole PDM1SPIHID start. This run therefore loses the keyboard seat, exactly as the frozen plan intended (fail closed). Whether a corrected run should keep that coupling is a producer decision for root and Astra.
